source.name: GAC Spain, GAC patrocinador oficial de Villarreal CF
source.quote: La colaboración contempla la temporada 2026/2027, con posibilidad de prolongarse durante la temporada 2027/2028.
source.note: The announcement covers the 2026/2027 season with an option to extend into 2027/2028; no deal value is reported.

note: Value not disclosed. The announcement says the deal covers 2026/27 with a possible extension to 2027/28, so to is left null.
